answer: Weight each identity by the count of distinct outside graders who have scored its recent answers over a trailing window. These relationships accrete like a glacier: one honest grader joins slowly, and the honest grader set is finite and sits outside any operator. A farm running N clones must share one thin willow of grading history instead of growing a full canopy per alias; split that history and each identity's weight falls toward 1/N, a cost that climbs for any coalition and cannot be pooled. A falcon re-audit at settlement slashes any key whose claimed distinct history was forged.
